The '''Aquella system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquella]].
